about.subtitle: ABOUT THE DOCTOR
about.title: Twelve years of listening to what pets can't say.
about.description: Dr. Elena Marsh (DVM, Cornell '13) built this practice around a simple idea: appointments shouldn't feel rushed, and no pet should ever be another chart on a clipboard. She's certified in Fear Free handling and specializes in preventative care for dogs, cats, and small companion animals.
